title: NFL tells Senator that Jalen Hurts review will include "mutually agreed-upon independent medical experts"

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: NFL tells Senator that Jalen Hurts review will include "mutually agreed-upon independent medical experts"
sources.description: Five weeks since Eagles quarterback Jalen Hurts played a game in London with a blood clot in his leg, the NFL and NFL Players Association have not yet begun an official investigation of the situation.
